prerequisites.description: Whether through an elixir of two worlds (see page 62) or other means
one of your parents was aquatic and the other was a land-dweller. You are mostly a normal member of your race
and you can’t have other feats
or abilities that specify your bloodline such as Racial Heritage APG . Thematically appropriate backgrounds include Adopted Outside Your Race
and The Relative. These backgrounds are found in Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Intrigue
